topics.justification: Top terms point to physical entropy collection (hardware, noise, CPU/time measurement) and distinguishing “true” randomness vs software PRNGs.
Words like function/code/implementation/class/library/openssl and fast/slow suggest discussions about practical API usage, versions, and performance tradeoffs in RNG implementations.
Emphasis on generate/random_number/seed/sequence/range/distribution plus “guess/bad” reflects questions about producing numbers correctly and why weak seeds lead to predictable sequences.

topics.topic_name: CSPRNG security model: state compromise & predictability
topics.justification: Terms like output/state/internal_state/attacker/attack/deterministic/seed capture how PRNG security depends on hidden state and resistance to prediction or compromise.
Strong signals from devrandom/devurandom/kernel/entropy_pool/boot/block/read indicate Linux/OS behavior, blocking semantics, and seeding from system entropy pools.
High weight on bit/test/byte/sample/pass/fail and hash hints at statistical tests, sampling sizes, and evaluating outputs for bias/entropy at the bit level.

topics.topic_name: General cryptographic-security guidance for RNG use
topics.justification: Broad terms (security/secure/cryptography/design/standard/implement/understand) suggest conceptual Q&A about why secure RNGs matter and recommended design practices.
Dominant “key” with generate/encrypt/encryption/secret/iv/mode/counter/stream/time_pad indicates generating cryptographic keys and IVs/nonces correctly for encryption schemes.

topics.topic_name: Breaking periodic ciphers / predictability over time
topics.justification: Words like rotor/letter/period/position/sequence/break/length point to classic cipher periodicity and how repeating patterns over time enable attacks (often tied to weak randomness).

topics.topic_name: Random tokens/IDs: UUIDs, hashes, salts & collisions
topics.justification: hash/string/unique/uuid/guid/token/salt/collision/password/user indicates generating unique identifiers or tokens and concerns about collisions and secure storage (salting/hashing).
